comments.why: Framework-agnostic, light on code, full of common sense.
comments.text: I watched this old talk from the YUI Library recently. It's framework-agnostic and not heavy on code, just a lot of common sense that might not be obvious for some. Nicholas Zakas: Scalable JavaScript Application Architecture [VIDEO]

comments.author: politician
comments.why: Zakas approach to scalable JavaScript architecture, implemented successfully.
comments.text: I've also successfully implemented Zakas' [1] approach after watching his presentation "Scalable Javascript Application Architecture" [2] and abandoning Backbone.Aura [3]. Aura theoretically implements this, but in practice we found that it made some assumptions that were incompatible with our needs. Consequently, we rolled our own implementation. [1] [LINK] [2] [VIDEO] [3] [LINK]
